bio: Treat yourself and someone special to a wonderful spa day with afternoon tea at Lifehouse Spa and Hotel Escape your hectic routine and take peaceful refuge with this wonderfully relaxing spa day at Lifehouse Spa and Hotel. You and someone special will be warmly welcomed by a member of the team before taking advantage of full access to the spa and leisure facilities. Enjoy a few leisurely lengths in the swimming pool followed by a soak in the hydrotherapy pool. On a sunny day, you can explore the idyllic gardens or sunbathe by the lake â€“ donâ€TMt forget to bring a good book. You and your loved one will also be treated to an appetising afternoon tea of freshly prepared sandwiches, fruit scones, served with lashings of clotted cream and jam, sweet treats and your choice of tea or coffee. Perfect!
